description: Capture the screen and run approved desktop actions on macOS or Windows for any app. Use context/apps/windows/select_app/select_window focus=false to understand and choose an app/window, click only to mark a target with the virtual AI cursor, and use type with text to enter words such as hello. Chrome background_control is only an optional Chrome-specific DOM route when app=Google Chrome is explicit; computer_use itself is not browser-specific.

config.name: computer_use
config.summary: 全アプリ向けのコンピューター操作。まず action=context/apps/windows で開いているアプリとウィンドウを確認し、select_app/select_window focus=false で対象を選びます。文字入力は action=type と text を優先してください。Chrome DOM背景入力は app=Google Chrome が明示された時だけの任意ルートで、通常の操作はVivaldi/VS Code/Finder/LINEなど全アプリが対象です。

action.description: Use context/apps/windows to inspect open apps, select_app/select_window with app/title and focus=false to target one app, click to place the virtual AI cursor/marker, type to enter text, key for shortcuts or single keys, and screenshot to inspect.

text.description: Text to enter when action is type. Prefer this over repeated key presses for words.

key.description: Single key or shortcut key for action=key, for example backspace, return, or a with modifier=meta.

modifier.description: Optional single key modifier such as meta, command, control, shift, or alt.

scope.description: For action=apps: running, installed, or all.

open.description: For select_app: launch an installed app if it is not already running.

background.description: For Chrome only: request DOM/Apple Events background text/key entry when foreground focus is not allowed.

driver.description: Optional driver hint such as auto, chrome_background_dom, foreground_input, or physical.

allow_foreground_fallback.description: Allow the tool to focus the target app and use foreground keyboard input if a background route is blocked.

allow_user_input_overlap.description: Set true only when the user says overlapping with their input is acceptable.

settings_fields.label: Default Target
settings_fields.help: Default desktop target for new tasks; request-specific details are supplied at call time.

settings_fields.label: Default Mode
settings_fields.help: Preferred operating mode before issuing desktop actions.

settings_fields.label: Safety Default
settings_fields.help: Durable safety preference for desktop operations.

settings_fields.label: Screenshot Quality
settings_fields.help: Default screenshot/detail preference for visual inspection.
